title: Not bad, BUT…
body:
Not sure what I’m even paying a subscription for. The app doesn’t offer any solid features.

Let’s talk goals. They’re hidden inside a card — which is dumb. To track progress, I have to tap into it every time. Why not just show a progress bar on the card? There’s tons of unused space there.

Also, why is there no option to compete with friends or other users? Add clear categories (like alcohol, cigarettes, etc.) and give us a leaderboard. Give me real motivation.

Right now it’s just a bunch of square timers. That’s it.
